headline: Municipality of Lima sends four buses without permits to storage facilities

author: NA
content: They were intercepted in block 49 of Aviation Avenue near Oval Higuereta in Surco where they used the road as an illegal stop. These vehicles will remain stored until their owners can pay off the debt or have them auctioned through SAT.
